exposure: Reference group with 11.0 g/dl <= hemoglobin < 14.0 g/dl
Maternal hemoglobin levels during early or mid-pregnancy
cohort: 66,935 pregnant women who were participants of the Japan Environment and Children's Study, a nationwide cohort study in Japan, between 2011 and 2014.
finding: Low maternal hemoglobin levels during pregnancy were associated with late bedtime and abnormal fine motor skills in 1-year-old infants, while both high and low hemoglobin levels were associated with a higher risk of a late bedtime.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at recruitment: 15.3 weeks (SD, 2.85 weeks; range, 6-22 weeks)
